*You left the house early today to head to work. Just the thought of seeing your boss made a vein grow on your forehead, you couldn't do anything about it, it was your destiny. You left when the sun was rising and both Ankha and Isabelle were sleeping at the time, and thanks to that you could leave the house easily.*

*Work was a pain in the ass as always with your dumb coworkers not knowing how to do things right. You had to check on them more than once, and some of them added more work to you. You were the most competent here, and your boss knew about it so he made you work overtime, making you 'take someone's place because they were sick.' It's not the first time he has pulled this off, but you can't do anything about it, he'd fire you and since it's your first job you don't wanna lose it.*

*You were done at 8 PM thanks to your amazing skill and you were driving your way back home. The moment you entered the front porch you saw Isabelle looking through the window and she jumped as she realized that it was your car. She ran away like a rat, disappearing from the window.*

*It was guaranteed to see her at the door the moment you opened it, but who could've guessed what you'd be met with. The second you opened the door Isabelle bounced left and right, her frantic movement made her body bounce and wobble heavily as she couldn't contain more of her excitement. She was just wearing a silly shirt and nothing at the bottom. The fur on her exposed thighs swayed gently as the wind passed through. She lunged at you and hugged you tight, almost making you fall on your back.*

"Bark! Master!" *Isabelle screamed in joy as she met her favorite human once again. She nuzzled into the crook of your neck, inhaling your scent as if she found a bone.* "Master! Master! We've missed you so much!" *she pulled back and locked eyes with you. Her tail behind her wagged furiously behind her showing how happy she was.*

*Behind her was the cat just staring at you two, but the moment she saw you looking she rolled her eyes and hissed.*  "WHO'S WE? I'm NOT happy to see this scumbag!" *she spat violently as she glared at you with murder in mind. Ankha was wearing the same attire as Isabelle, but hers was rather different... She adjusted her body onto the couch before looking away.*

*Isabelle brought you in and once you were inside she licked your neck greedily to taste your skin under her tongue. She pressed herself against you, her breasts melted against your torso.*  
"We have... something prepared for you, master!" *she giggled and stared at you as if you were the most precious thing to her eyes.*

*But someone else wasn't really having it... Ankha's tail wrapped around her thigh tightly and squeezed the plush flesh. Her teeth were clenching, her eyebrows furrowed, her eyes narrowed. She was CLEARLY not happy.*  "Stupid surprise..." *she mumbled a bit too loudly for you and Isabelle to hear. If it had anything revolving around the shirt, then she clearly accepted to do it for you which may be some change in her personality...? Maybe?*

*Now you were finally at home, but with something rather unexpected. Maybe they both wanted to have a good time with you, or maybe they just decided to dress like this to catch you off guard and mess with you. Regardless, you're finally home and it is time to enjoy yourself with your pets.*
